A1.justification: Both contain the same 31-page Mufu paper, including Appendices A.1-A.8. Page-by-page text and rendering comparisons establish identical substantive content; the only visible difference is v3's publication header.

before.justification: v2 reports original translation experiments on FLORES-200 and NTREX, including chrF/BLEU results, ablations, attention analyses, and appendix BLOOMZ evaluations.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original translation experiments and results, including the main-text evaluations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The teacher-generated auxiliary translations, student postediting and finetuning, language selection, and distillation procedures are identical.

E1.justification: Both retain FLORES-200 evaluation over 201 English-to-target directions and NTREX over 112. Pretraining and distillation data, language/script coverage, and appendix scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same baseline and postediting variants, PaLM2 S teacher, NLLB 1.3B distilled, and NLLB 54B MoE comparators. Appendix comparator membership also matches.

E3.justification: Data splits, chrF/BLEU metrics, model configurations, training budgets, checkpoint selection, and decoding procedures are identical in Section 3 and Appendix A.3.

E4.justification: The auxiliary-language and postediting ablations, LoRA and distillation analyses, attention studies, domain-shift evaluation, and failure examples are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Figures 2 and 4 retain identical 95% confidence intervals across language pairs. No run-count, seed, or statistical-procedure information is added, removed, or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including the main chrF results, appendix BLEU and per-language scores, BLOOMZ results, plotted findings, and translation examples.

T1.justification: Mathematical content and reasoning are identical. No definitions, formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added, removed, or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and discussion retain identical claims about data-efficient low-resource translation, multilingual reasoning, robustness, and distillation.

C2.justification: The attention-based explanations, overfitting and domain-shift interpretations, poor-auxiliary failure conditions, and inference-cost limitations remain unchanged, including the appendix discussion.

D1.justification: Prompt templates, auxiliary-language lists, learning rates, training and decoding details, and model/data access information are identical. PDF hyperlink targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 5, citations, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior work are identical. The publication notice does not alter the research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 adds the running header 'Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025'. Body prose, terminology, author information, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The publication header appears on every page in v3. Figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, pagination, and all content below the header render identically.

improvement.justification: v3 adds only the ICLR 2025 publication header. Scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
